3: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek my soul: let them be turned backward and put to shame, that wish me evil.
4: Let them that say to me, Aha, aha, be turned back and put to shame immediately.
5: Let all that seek you exult and be glad in you: and let those that love your salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.
6: But I am poor and needy; O God, help me: you are my helper and deliverer, O Lord, delay not.
